svg.title: AnyScan architecture
svg.desc: How AnyScan turns a camera frame into a reading. Background subtraction and FastSAM are two independent cues fused so an object survives if either finds it; each object records its cue. Each object is cropped, enhanced and described by Gemma 4; Reporting composes the reading and the objects are measured through the calibration scale. One configuration file, read by Configuration.Core, sets the camera, the models, the prompts, the fusion and the thresholds. One formatter renders both the panel and the text file. The layers import downward only, with Parameters at the base; everything below the UI is Qt-free.

svg.aria-label: AnyScan — The camera sees, the model describes.
svg.title: AnyScan
svg.desc: AnyScan logo: inside a camera scan frame, an object is located by a magenta bounding box with an index tag and its generated text description; beside it the AnyScan wordmark and the tagline "The camera sees, the model describes."
svg.text: The camera sees, the model describes.
what the code does today, and what imports what
one shot from this camera; its sidecar
is checked against the sensor window
Fusion — an object survives if either cue finds it
FastSAM union (background-like masks dropped) OR the foreground mask
→ close → connected components → area filter → left to right;
each object records the cue(s) that located it
per object: Mask · Bbox · Cue = both | fastsam | background
padded crop; every other object filled from the reference;
contrast-stretched from the object’s own pixels
object prompt on each Enhanced_Crop → Detail → Condense_Label → Label
background prompt on the reference, once (cached) → background sentence

g.text: Label · Detail per object + one background sentence
each object’s Sentence, the scene note and the verdict — objects are never reordered
each mask through the scale: A × B, Ø, or A/F for hex parts; none without one
Analysis_Str → the UI, via a worker off the GUI thread
PyQt5 — Live · Trends · History · Log, Configuration dialog, Workers
imports Vision · Logger · Camera · Configuration · Reporting · Parameters (App/run.py → UI + domain)
*_Str dataclasses and Theme tokens — imports nothing of the project
Not drawn: src/Transformation (inherited; the app never imports it) and the model-free fallback describer (analyze.py --no-describe only).
